cues.en: So how do we show an error message here?

that this message will only be shown
if we make it into this if statement,
which will only be the case if at least
one of these conditions here is met.

we can use another built-in function provided by Flutter,
and this time it will be the showDialog function,
which will show some info or error dialogue on the screen,
some popup on the screen you could say.
ShowDialog, just like showDatePicker
or showModalBottomSheet before wants a context value,
which we set to this context object
that's available in this state class.
And it wants such a builder function,
which should be a function that takes some context
as an input and returns a widget as a value.
And that widget will simply be the content
of that pop-up dialogue that will be shown.
So here we get this context
provided by Flutter automatically
when it executes this builder method.
And the widget I wanna return here
will be one of the built-in dialogue widgets.
Now there are a couple of built-in dialogue widgets
and I'm interested in the alert dialogue,
which is a dialogue styled and optimized
for showing some alert message.
The alert dialogue widget then has a couple of parameters
that can be set.
For example, a title parameter, which wants another widget
where I'll use the text widget
to give this pop-up window a title.
For example, invalid input.
And this can be converted to a constant text.
I'll not convert the overall AlertDialog

the main content shown in the dialogue.
